Clause 9.5.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect and preserve the identified period buildings within the precinct and encourage their sympathetic alteration or restoration.

Clause 9.5.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identifi ed Heritage I tems within the precinct.

Clause 9.5.2 - height_limit (development_control): To mainta in distinctly single storey streetscapes within the precinct.

Clause 9.5.2 - other (development_control): To protect  significant streetscape and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering , views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.5.2 - other (development_control): To preserve the predominantly medium density residential character comprising terrace/row housing on individual allotments within the precinct.

Clause 9.5.2 - parking (development_control): To ensure the provision and location of off -street car p arking does not adversely impact t he amenity of the precinct.

Clause 9.5.2 - heritage (heritage): To protect the identified values of the Lewisham Estate H eritage C onservation Area .

Clause 9.5.2 - other (development_control): To ensure orderly development on masterplan sites in accordance with the principles of the masterplan vision, including allotment amalgamations,  where required, that are not detrimental to achieving the overall masterplan structure and achieve an efficient and high quality built outcome.
